issue.title: Bug: Drop counters backend ACL setup can use a different DUT than the selected frontend DUT

failure.body:
## Description

`tests/drop_packets/test_drop_counters.py` selects a frontend DUT using `enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname`, but the autouse `handle_backend_acl` fixture uses the implicit `duthost` fixture.

In multi-DUT topologies, DATAACL cleanup/recreation can be executed on a different DUT than the DUT selected for the drop counter tests.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Run `drop_packets/test_drop_counters.py` on a dualtor or other multi-DUT topology.
2. Inspect `handle_backend_acl` and the test/helper paths that select `duthosts[enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname]`.
3. Observe that `handle_backend_acl` takes `duthost` directly.

## Actual behavior

Backend ACL setup uses implicit `duthost`.

Reference dualtor execution:

```text
tst-esx-62/drop_packets/test_drop_counters.xml:
topology=dualtor-aa-56, testbed=dtAA56, host=gd377, tests=102, failures=0, errors=0, skipped=68

tst-esx-63/drop_packets/test_drop_counters.xml:
topology=dualtor, testbed=dt, host=ldp203, tests=102, failures=0, errors=0, skipped=68
```

Additional runtime selection evidence:

```text
tst-esx-62 XML has suite host=gd377 while the 34 non-skipped testcases are parametrized with [gd426].
tst-esx-63 XML has suite host=ldp203 while the 34 non-skipped testcases are parametrized with [ldp205].
```

## Expected behavior

Backend ACL setup should use the selected frontend DUT:

```python
duthost = duthosts[enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname]
```

## Impact

DATAACL setup can affect a different DUT than the selected DUT used by the test.

## Test image

```text
branch.202605-ars.8512e7eb-buildimage.ad6f5b869a8cacb3cb7eefe7dc226bf6f85480ff-nightly-2026.08.25.14.40
```

## Relevant log output

Before-fix evidence:

[drop_counters_before_fix_logs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31609257/drop_counters_before_fix_logs.zip)
